statement: Let M be a number field, let N ⊂ Qs be a number field, and let φ : GM → PN be open. Fix an odd prime ℓ. Every prime v ∤ ℓ active at ℓ determines a unique prime w ∤ ℓ of N for which, with suitable prolongations, φ(Dv) ⊂ Dw. Moreover, φ is injective on a pro-ℓ Sylow subgroup of Iv, and sends this subgroup into Iw. All but finitely many primes of N arise from such active primes of M.
